function TItem.PresentationDescriptionBox( aShort : Boolean ): Ansistring;
begin
  PresentationDescriptionBox := '';
  if FProps.IType = ITEMTYPE_RELIC then Exit( DRLViewFirstPerkText(Self, 'desc', GetFirstPerkDescription) );
  case FProps.IType of
    ITEMTYPE_ARMOR, ITEMTYPE_BOOTS : PresentationDescriptionBox :=
      DRLText('view.description-box.durability', 'Durability  : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.MaxDurability)])+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime  <> 10, DRLText('view.description-box.swap-time', 'Swap time   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.SwapTime))]));
    ITEMTYPE_URANGED : PresentationDescriptionBox :=
      DRLText('view.description-box.damage-type', 'Damage type : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewDamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType, DamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType)))])+
      IIf(FProps.Radius <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.explosion-radius', 'Expl.radius : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Radius)]));
    ITEMTYPE_RANGED, ITEMTYPE_NRANGED : PresentationDescriptionBox :=
      IIf(FProps.UseTime  <> 10, DRLText('view.description-box.fire-time', 'Fire time   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.UseTime))]))+
      IIf(FProps.ReloadTime > 0, DRLText('view.description-box.reload-time', 'Reload time : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.ReloadTime))]))+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime <> 10, DRLText('view.description-box.swap-time', 'Swap time   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.SwapTime))]))+
      IIf(FProps.Acc       <> 0, DRLText('view.description-box.accuracy', 'Accuracy    : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(FProps.Acc))]))+
      DRLText('view.description-box.damage-type', 'Damage type : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewDamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType, DamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType)))])+
      IIf(FProps.Shots    <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.shots', 'Shots       : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Shots)]))+
      IIf(FProps.ShotCost <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.shot-cost', 'Shot cost   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.ShotCost)]))+
      IIf(FProps.Radius   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.explosion-radius', 'Expl.radius : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Radius)]))+
      IIf(FProps.Falloff  <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.damage-falloff', 'Dmg. falloff: {!{{value}}%}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Falloff)]))+
      IIf(FProps.Spread   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.cone-size', 'Cone size   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Spread)]))+
      IIf(FProps.Range    <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.max-range', 'Max range   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLIntegerParam('value', FProps.Range)]))+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltFire ),  DRLText('view.description-box.alt-fire', 'Alt. fire   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewItemPerkText(Self, Hook_OnAltFire, 'short', GetAltFireName))]))+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltReload ),DRLText('view.description-box.alt-reload', 'Alt. reload : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewItemPerkText(Self, Hook_OnAltReload, 'short', GetAltReloadName))]));
    ITEMTYPE_MELEE : PresentationDescriptionBox :=
      IIf(FProps.UseTime <> 10, DRLText('view.description-box.attack-time', 'Attack time : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.UseTime))]))+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime<> 10, DRLText('view.description-box.swap-time', 'Swap time   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Seconds(FProps.SwapTime))]))+
      IIf(FProps.Acc     <> 0,  DRLText('view.description-box.accuracy', 'Accuracy    : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(FProps.Acc))]))+
      DRLText('view.description-box.damage-type', 'Damage type : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewDamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType, DamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType)))])+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltFire ),  DRLText('view.description-box.alt-fire', 'Alt. fire   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', DRLViewItemPerkText(Self, Hook_OnAltFire, 'short', GetAltFireName))]));
  end;
  PresentationDescriptionBox +=
    IIf(FProps.MoveMod  <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.move-speed', 'Move speed  : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Percent(FProps.MoveMod))]))+
    IIf(FProps.KnockMod <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.knockback', 'Knockback   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Percent(FProps.KnockMod))]))+
    IIf(FProps.DodgeMod <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.dodge-rate', 'Dodge rate  : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', Percent(FProps.DodgeMod))]));

  PresentationDescriptionBox +=
      IIf(GetResistance('bullet')   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.bullet-resistance', 'Bullet res. : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('bullet')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('melee')    <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.melee-resistance', 'Melee res.  : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('melee')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('shrapnel') <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.shrapnel-resistance', 'Shrapnel res: {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('shrapnel')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('acid')     <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.acid-resistance', 'Acid res.   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('acid')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('fire')     <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.fire-resistance', 'Fire res.   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('fire')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('plasma')   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.plasma-resistance', 'Plasma res. : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('plasma')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('cold')     <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.cold-resistance', 'Cold res.   : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('cold')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('poison')   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.poison-resistance', 'Poison res. : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('poison')))]))+
      IIf(GetResistance('pierce')   <> 0,DRLText('view.description-box.pierce-resistance', 'Pierce res. : {!{{value}}}'#10, [DRLStringParam('value', BonusStr(GetResistance('pierce')))]));
end;

  if FProps.IType = ITEMTYPE_RELIC then Exit( GetFirstPerkDescription );
  case FProps.IType of
    ITEMTYPE_ARMOR, ITEMTYPE_BOOTS : DescriptionBox :=
      'Durability  : {!'+IntToStr(FProps.MaxDurability)+'}'#10+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime  <> 10, 'Swap time   : {!'+Seconds(FProps.SwapTime)+'}'#10);

      'Damage type : {!'+DamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType)+'}'#10+
      IIf(FProps.Radius <> 0,'Expl.radius : {!'+IntToStr(FProps.Radius)+'}'#10);
    ITEMTYPE_RANGED, ITEMTYPE_NRANGED : DescriptionBox :=
      IIf(FProps.UseTime  <> 10, 'Fire time   : {!'+Seconds(FProps.UseTime)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.ReloadTime > 0, 'Reload time : {!'+Seconds(FProps.ReloadTime)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime <> 10, 'Swap time   : {!'+Seconds(FProps.SwapTime)+'}'#10)+

      IIf(FProps.Radius   <> 0,'Expl.radius : {!'+IntToStr(FProps.Radius)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.Falloff  <> 0,'Dmg. falloff: {!'+IntToStr(FProps.Falloff)+'%}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.Spread   <> 0,'Cone size   : {!'+IntToStr(FProps.Spread)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.Range    <> 0,'Max range   : {!'+IntToStr(FProps.Range)+'}'#10)+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltFire ),  'Alt. fire   : {!'+GetAltFireName+'}'#10)+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltReload ),'Alt. reload : {!'+GetAltReloadName+'}'#10);
    ITEMTYPE_MELEE : DescriptionBox :=
      IIf(FProps.UseTime <> 10, 'Attack time : {!'+Seconds(FProps.UseTime)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.SwapTime<> 10, 'Swap time   : {!'+Seconds(FProps.SwapTime)+'}'#10)+
      IIf(FProps.Acc     <> 0,  'Accuracy    : {!' + BonusStr(FProps.Acc)+'}'#10)+
      'Damage type : {!'+DamageTypeName(FProps.DamageType)+'}'#10+
      IIf((not aShort) and HasHook( Hook_OnAltFire ),  'Alt. fire   : {!'+GetAltFireName+'}'#10);
  end;
  DescriptionBox +=
    IIf(FProps.MoveMod  <> 0,'Move speed  : {!'+Percent(FProps.MoveMod)+'}'#10)+
    IIf(FProps.KnockMod <> 0,'Knockback   : {!'+Percent(FProps.KnockMod)+'}'#10)+
    IIf(FProps.DodgeMod <> 0,'Dodge rate  : {!'+Percent(FProps.DodgeMod)+'}'#10);

  DescriptionBox +=
      IIf(GetResistance('bullet')   <> 0,'Bullet res. : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('bullet'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('melee')    <> 0,'Melee res.  : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('melee'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('shrapnel') <> 0,'Shrapnel res: {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('shrapnel'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('acid')     <> 0,'Acid res.   : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('acid'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('fire')     <> 0,'Fire res.   : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('fire'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('plasma')   <> 0,'Plasma res. : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('plasma'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('cold')     <> 0,'Cold res.   : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('cold'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('poison')   <> 0,'Poison res. : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('poison'))+'}'#10)+
      IIf(GetResistance('pierce')   <> 0,'Pierce res. : {!' + BonusStr(GetResistance('pierce'))+'}'#10);

function TItem.DescriptionBox( aShort : Boolean = False ): Ansistring;
